source_evidence: The official DataCORE landing page reports raw TEM diffraction data for chromium telluride nanoplates.
The methodology states that SAED patterns were recorded along [001] and [112] zone axes.
The description states that diffraction data are supplied as TIFF images and original Gatan DM4 files.
The record has DOI 10.5967/ct7n-8275, reports three dataset files totaling 18.4 MB, and uses a CC BY 4.0 license.
The related publication reports TEM studies using a 120 kV JEOL JEM 1400plus.
The related publication states that the main spots in both SAED patterns can be indexed by Cr1+deltaTe2 with delta approximately 0.5.
blocking_evidence: The landing page does not expose an archive checksum or per-member checksums.
Camera length or a traceable camera constant, detector metadata, pattern center, immutable sample IDs, and acquisition IDs are not established by the landing-page or publication metadata.
The independence of the two stated zone-axis patterns has not been verified.
The DM4-to-TIFF relationship and preservation of original intensity values have not been audited.
The publication-level phase and zone-axis statements are not yet checksum-bound to specific source files and cannot be used for parameter tuning.
candidates.next_validation_step: Resolve the official Diffraction_Pattern.zip file-delivery response, bind the archive and every member by SHA-256, inspect DM4 metadata without modifying arrays, compare DM4 and TIFF representations, and verify at least two independent acquisitions before creating a real-data validation case.

registry_decision.next_action: complete the checksum-bound raw-file and metadata audit
registry_decision.scientific_boundary: Do not tune center, smoothing, prominence, radius bounds, or candidate count against the reported zone axes or publication indexing statement. No phase, reflection, zone-axis, d-spacing accuracy, or engineering claim is allowed before raw-file audit, acquisition-lineage verification, calibration verification, and protocol freeze.
